verses.restored: Unto thee will I cry, O YHWH my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

familiar.text: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

modern.text: To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.

original.text: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר

verses.restored: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

familiar.text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

modern.text: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.

original.text: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ

verses.restored: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

familiar.text: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

modern.text: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.

original.text: אַל תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם

verses.restored: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

familiar.text: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

modern.text: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.

original.text: תֶּן לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: Because they regard not the works of YHWH, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

familiar.text: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

modern.text: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.

original.text: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם

verses.restored: Blessed be YHWH, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

familiar.text: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

modern.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.

original.text: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי

verses.restored: YHWH is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

familiar.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

modern.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

original.text: יְהוָ֤ה עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: YHWH is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

familiar.text: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

modern.text: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.

original.text: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא

verses.restored: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

familiar.text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

modern.text: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.

original.text: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה אֶת עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד הָעוֹלָֽם

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Calls for repayment according to deeds are placed before God, not handed to private vengeance; leaders remain accountable.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
